title: House and GPO filename metadata records
description: Guide conventions and observed filename layouts. Metadata validation only; calendar dates, URL structure and UTF-8 filename length also require the runtime. This is not certification of current House requirements.

field_measureTypeLower.description: Selected output spelling: lowercase, matching numbered-measure samples. Not a source-wide rule about case.

field_legislativeStage.description: Stage codes printed in the 2012 appendix; no current completeness or type/chamber compatibility claim.

field_committeeCode.description: Filename code syntax only. Two-character committee examples and four-character subcommittee examples are both represented. The appendix labels its four-character codes as folder codes; no folder-to-filename alias is inferred.

field_bioguideId.description: Syntax only. Does not require membership in the 112th-Congress directory.

field_filenameToken.description: Selected safe single filename value: no whitespace, path separators or control characters. No transliteration, case conversion or punctuation cleanup is performed. Resource and portability bounds are implementation constraints. A trailing -U<digits> is reserved; no Unicode normalization is performed.

field_witnessId.description: Supply the prepared last-name-plus-first-initial token or a member Bioguide ID. The schema cannot establish that this token matches a real person or that a name was prepared correctly. Resource and portability bounds are implementation constraints. A trailing -U<digits> is reserved; no Unicode normalization is performed.

field_date8.description: YYYYMMDD lexical check. Calendar validity is checked by the included adapter, not this regular expression.

field_fiscalYear.description: Printed two- or four-digit fiscal year. No century is inferred for a two-digit year.

field_sequenceId.description: Digits preserved exactly. No fixed padding width is inferred from a sample.

field_amendmentId.description: Literal local amendment identifier, including letters and underscores. Enbloc and terminal revision suffixes are separate fields.

field_extension.description: Deliberately bounded output convention: PDF and XML extensions observed in this source. Not a claim that the source prohibits every other extension.

field_revision.description: Omit for the initial posting. The adapter appends -U followed by this number before the extension.

field_meetingOccurrence.description: Omit for the first meeting that day; subsequent occurrences become a -2, -3, ... suffix.

field_committee_print_link_url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL. The runtime applies deterministic structural checks, including prepared ASCII URI spelling and percent escapes; format is an annotation for external consumers. No URL is fetched and no publisher is authenticated.

field_hearing_transcript_link_url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL. The runtime applies deterministic structural checks, including prepared ASCII URI spelling and percent escapes; format is an annotation for external consumers. No URL is fetched and no publisher is authenticated.

field_witnessMeetingType.description: Original collection prefix. Defaults to HHRG for existing witness records; observed HMTG and HMKP prefixes are preserved.

field_numberedDocumentType.description: Printed document marker: supporting document or questions for the record.

field_unnumberedDocumentType.description: Printed document markers MbrRoster, CPg, and TOC are preserved as metadata.

field_hearingPublicationType.description: GPO hearing publication type printed in the package identifier.

field_hearingPublicationSuffix.description: Printed publication suffix retained verbatim, alongside separately extracted explicit part, volume, addendum and errata tokens.

field_publicationExtension.description: Observed government publication filename extensions; no content format validation.

field_publicationPartId.description: Printed part, volume, addendum or errata identifier. Empty means an unnumbered marker is present; omission means absent.

field_witnessIdType.description: The entire witness identifier has Bioguide syntax; identity is not verified.

field_reportDocumentType.description: A congressional report. Conference status is not established by the filename.

field_reportPublicationType.description: Printed House, Senate, or Senate executive report code.

field_versionSuffix.description: Literal suffix after the legislative stage; retains occurrence, annotation and local descriptive text.

field_stageOccurrence.description: Printed occurrence following a version code; distinct from a document revision.

field_annotation.description: Text inside a printed parenthetical annotation.

field_appropriationType.description: Explicit suppl or CR marker within the AP/FY description; no annual status is inferred from its absence.

field_voteIdentifier.description: Literal vote identifier, range or label; no range expansion or vote count is inferred.

field_amendmentSubject.description: Selected safe single filename value: no whitespace, path separators or control characters. No transliteration, case conversion or punctuation cleanup is performed. Resource and portability bounds are implementation constraints. A trailing -U<digits> is reserved; no Unicode normalization is performed.

field_references.description: Literal references found within known filename fields. Offsets are zero-based character positions [start,end) in sourceField. Related mentions never replace primary metadata, establish document relationships, or supply a missing source slot.

measureType.description: Selected output spelling: lowercase, matching numbered-measure samples. Not a source-wide rule about case.

year.description: Printed two- or four-digit fiscal year. No century is inferred for a two-digit year.

field_observedCongress.description: Three-digit Congress slot in observed incomplete layouts; fixes the boundary before an adjacent untyped numeric token.

field_untypedNumberToken.description: Printed numeric slot with no measure type. Leading zeros and zero placeholders survive; no bill identity is inferred.

field_observedDraftStage.description: Literal House pre-introduction marker in observed drafts without a measure-type slot; not added to the GovInfo version vocabulary.

field_draftDescription.description: Selected safe single filename value: no whitespace, path separators or control characters. No transliteration, case conversion or punctuation cleanup is performed. Resource and portability bounds are implementation constraints. A trailing -U<digits> is reserved; no Unicode normalization is performed.

field_incompleteAppropriationRouting.description: Observed incomplete AP routing: optional literal prefix, optional FC/SC/ORH, then AP description. Complete measure-type/stage layouts are excluded. Unknown prefix text is retained without assigning a measure or person.

field_untypedLegislativeStage.description: Observed legislative stages: the version vocabulary plus House PIH. PIH remains a House marker, not a GovInfo version.

field_optionalMeasureToken.description: Explicit measure-type slot, or the empty string when absent. An absent type is not inferred.

field_numberPlaceholder.description: Literal placeholder or empty number slot; not a zero, bill number, or missing-value substitute.

field_namedDraftLabel.description: Observed printed label. No acronym expansion or document-content assertion.

field_draftIdentifier.description: Printed local draft identifier, including placeholders and leading zeros.

field_introducedDraftStage.description: Explicit IH/PIH suffix in descriptive legislative filenames. Restriction avoids stripping arbitrary short version-looking endings from words.

field_draftDescriptor.description: Literal descriptive text ending before an explicit IH/PIH stage. No person-name splitting or expansion.

field_numberedSubject.description: Retained numbered subject. Only an explicit known measure type permits deriving a measure identity.

field_measureList.description: One or more adjacent explicit measure references. Each occurrence is extracted independently; no primary measure is selected.

field_measureListPrefix.description: Literal optional SA prefix before the reference list. No legislative-version label is assigned.

field_measureListSuffix.description: Literal suffix after the legislative stage; retains occurrence, annotation and local descriptive text.

field_numberedDraftDescriptor.description: Literal descriptive text ending before an explicit IH/PIH stage. No person-name splitting or expansion.

field_unnumberedVersionSuffix.description: Literal suffix after the legislative stage; retains occurrence, annotation and local descriptive text.

field_amendmentSuffix.description: Literal suffix after HAmdt, not an amendment number. The guide identifies empty, 2 and 3 as first, second and third degree; other spellings remain uninterpreted.

field_amendmentDegree.description: Interchamber amendment degree identified by HAmdt/SAmdt, HAmdt2/SAmdt2, or HAmdt3/SAmdt3. Not an amendment sequence number.

field_govinfoPrintPublicationType.description: GovInfo committee print codes: hprt (House), sprt (Senate), jprt (joint), wprt (House Ways and Means). See https://www.govinfo.gov/help/cprt.
